data.name: Bennett
data.gender_notes: Bennett is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bennett is derived from the Old English words 'behn' meaning 'little' and 'net' meaning 'blessed'. The name was originally given to those who were small in stature but blessed with great qualities. In Christianity, the name Bennett is associated with St. Bennet, a 7th-century Anglo-Saxon bishop. The name Bennett carries the meaning “Little, blessed” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bennett usually hope their child will grow to embody little, blessed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the blessing and protection of God.
data.etymology: Bennett belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little, blessed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bennett total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: בנט
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בנט מקורו בשם הלטיני בנדיקטוס, שמשמעותו מתנה מאלוהים, והוא נגזר מהמילים הלטיניות בנה ודיקטוס, שפירושן טוב ודיבר, ובהשאלה, הוא משמעותו מי שדיבר טוב, השם הפך לפופולרי בימי הביניים, והוא נושא ערך רוחני ותרבותי עמוק בנצרות

in_greek.name: Μπένετ
in_greek.long_meaning: το όνομα Μπένετ προέρχεται από το λατινικό όνομα Βενεδίκτος, που σημαίνει δωρεά του Θεού, και είναι γραμμένο στη λατινική ως Benedictus, που αποτελείται από τις λατινικές λέξεις benedictus και dictus, που σημαίνουν καλός και λεγόμενος, και σε μεταφορά, σημαίνει αυτός που λέγεται καλός, το όνομα αυτό ήταν δημοφιλές κατά τον Μεσαίωνα, και έχει μεγάλη πνευματική και πολιτιστική σημασία στο χριστιανισμό

in_latin.name: Bennettus
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen Bennettus derivatur a nomine Latino Benedictus, quod significat donum Dei, et constat ex verbis Latinis benedictus et dictus, quae significant bonus et dictus, et in translatione, significat is qui dicitur bonus, nomen hoc fuit populare in medio aevo, et habet magnam significationem spiritualem et culturalem in christianismo

in_english.name: Bennett
in_english.long_meaning: the name Bennett is derived from the Latin name Benedict, meaning blessed or fortunate one, and is composed of the Latin words benedictus and dictus, meaning good and spoken, and in transfer, it means one who is spoken well of, the name was popular in the Middle Ages, and has significant spiritual and cultural importance in Christianity

data.cultural_impact: The name Bennett has been popular amongst various Christian communities, particularly in England and Ireland, for centuries. It was once a common name for monks and priests, reflecting the spiritual significance of the name. Today, it is still a beloved name amongst Christians, reminding us of the importance of being small in our own eyes but blessed in the eyes of God.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Bennett carries a deep spiritual meaning, reminding us of the importance of humility and God's blessings. In the Bible, we see many examples of those who were considered small in the eyes of the world but were greatly blessed by God. The name Bennett serves as a reminder that true blessings come from God, and that no matter our size or stature, we can all live blessed lives through faith and humility.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Bennett is derived from the Hebrew name Bar-Hanan, which means "son of grace." It is a reminder of God's endless grace and favor towards His children. In Christian tradition, it symbolizes the idea of being a vessel of God's love and blessings to others.

biblical_reference.note: the name Bennett is not directly mentioned in the Bible, but its roots are in the Latin name Benedict, which is associated with Saint Benedict

historical_references.reference: English: from the Old English personal name Beonet, which is of uncertain origin, possibly from beon 'to fight' or from beonet 'battle' or from beonet 'bright' or from beonet 'white'.

trends: in 2019, Bennett was the 46th most popular boy name in England and Wales

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
